blocks.title: The big idea
blocks.body: Searching finds where a value is, or that it is missing. Linear search checks every item. Binary search needs sorted data and halves the problem each step.

blocks.title: Linear versus binary
items: Binary: sorted only, worst case $O(\log n)$
Both return an index, or -1 if not found
1,000,000 items: binary needs at most 20 looks
